dimension: Obstacle detection status relevant to braking decision
contrast_a: An obstacle is detected within the relevant dangerous zone / in time for braking
contrast_b: An obstacle is not detected, or not detected in time, for braking to be triggered

dimension: Obstacle relevance to the trajectory
contrast_a: The detected obstacle is on or close to the vehicle trajectory and therefore relevant to collision avoidance.
contrast_b: The detected object is not on or close to the trajectory and does not require braking for collision avoidance.

dimension: Obstacle requiring braking vs no such obstacle present
contrast_a: A relevant obstacle or road user is present such that braking is required to avoid collision
contrast_b: No relevant obstacle or road user is present, so braking is not required for collision avoidance

dimension: Obstacle / road-user presence in the vehicle's path-relevant scene
contrast_a: A situation in which a pedestrian or other obstacle is present on or close to the trajectory and is relevant to collision avoidance.
contrast_b: A situation in which no obstacle or road user is present on or close to the trajectory requiring braking for collision avoidance.

dimension: Obstacle / road-user presence in the vehicle's path-relevant scene
contrast_a: A situation in which a pedestrian or other obstacle is present on or close to the trajectory and is relevant to collision avoidance.
contrast_b: A situation in which no obstacle or road user is present on or close to the trajectory requiring braking for collision avoidance.

dimension: Distance to the obstacle / road user
contrast_a: A situation in which the obstacle or road user is sufficiently near that braking may be needed to avoid collision.
contrast_b: A situation in which the obstacle or road user is present but at a distance where braking is not yet needed for collision avoidance.

dimension: Timeliness of braking after obstacle detection in a dangerous zone
contrast_a: Braking starts within the required time after the obstacle is detected in the dangerous zone.
contrast_b: Braking starts too late to satisfy the timing requirement after obstacle detection in the dangerous zone.

dimension: Obstacle detection preceding braking obligation
contrast_a: The obstacle is detected in the dangerous zone and thus triggers the braking obligation
contrast_b: The obstacle is not detected in the dangerous zone, so the braking obligation is not triggered through that detection path

dimension: Obstacle presence relevant to braking
contrast_a: An obstacle/road user is detected on or close to the trajectory in the hazard-relevant situation
contrast_b: No such obstacle/road user is detected

dimension: Temporal relation between obstacle detection and braking initiation
contrast_a: Braking starts within the required/expected time after obstacle detection in the dangerous zone
contrast_b: Braking starts too late after obstacle detection to avoid collision

dimension: Obstacle presence relevant to braking
contrast_a: An obstacle/road user is detected on or close to the trajectory in the hazard-relevant situation
contrast_b: No such obstacle/road user is detected

dimension: Obstacle presence within the driving trajectory/dangerous zone
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is present such that braking is required to avoid collision
contrast_b: No obstacle requiring braking is present

dimension: Obstacle presence within the driving trajectory/dangerous zone
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is present such that braking is required to avoid collision
contrast_b: No obstacle requiring braking is present

dimension: Obstacle presence and detectability
contrast_a: A road user or static obstacle present in the driving scene and available for detection/interpretation.
contrast_b: No relevant obstacle present, or the obstacle is not available to the system for detection/interpretation.

dimension: braking-relevant obstacle presence and proximity
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is present within the situation such that collision avoidance depends on timely braking.
contrast_b: No such obstacle or the obstacle is not in a position where braking relevance arises for the evaluation.

dimension: braking-relevant obstacle presence and proximity
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is present within the situation such that collision avoidance depends on timely braking.
contrast_b: No such obstacle or the obstacle is not in a position where braking relevance arises for the evaluation.

dimension: Obstacle proximity to vehicle trajectory
contrast_a: The object is on or close to the vehicle trajectory and at a distance that makes braking relevant.
contrast_b: The object is not on or close to the trajectory, or is sufficiently distant that braking is not presently required.

dimension: obstacle category relevant to braking
contrast_a: A vulnerable road user or other obstacle/static obstacle that can trigger braking for collision avoidance
contrast_b: No relevant obstacle/road user present

dimension: obstacle proximity relevant to braking decision
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is sufficiently close to the ego vehicle/trajectory that braking may be needed to avoid collision
contrast_b: An obstacle or road user is not in a proximity state that can require braking to avoid collision

dimension: Obstacle/road-user presence in the vehicle's trajectory-relevant environment
contrast_a: A road user or obstacle is present in a situation requiring braking to avoid collision
contrast_b: No road user or obstacle is present in a situation requiring braking to avoid collision

dimension: Need for braking due to detected obstacle/road user
contrast_a: A situation in which an obstacle or road user is detected and braking is required to avoid collision.
contrast_b: A situation in which no obstacle or road user is present that requires braking.

dimension: Obstacle present in the relevant driving path vs. no such obstacle present
contrast_a: An obstacle or road user is present on or close enough to the trajectory to make braking relevant.
contrast_b: No obstacle or road user is present in the relevant driving path, so braking is not required on that basis.

dimension: Braking outcome
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes as intended to avoid an obstacle or other justified collision-avoidance situation.
contrast_b: The vehicle brakes unexpectedly / unintentionally when no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.

dimension: braking initiation context
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes because an obstacle is detected in front of it and braking is part of collision avoidance.
contrast_b: The vehicle brakes or stops while no obstacle is in front of the vehicle, i.e., without a collision-avoidance basis.

dimension: Braking state in the declared operational situation
contrast_a: Vehicle brakes or suddenly stops without an obstacle in front
contrast_b: Vehicle does not brake unexpectedly while continuing normal driving

dimension: Braking state
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes unexpectedly without an obstacle in front
contrast_b: The vehicle does not brake unexpectedly in the same driving situation

dimension: presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the vehicle in the driving scene.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the vehicle in the driving scene.

dimension: Presence of an obstacle relevant to initiating braking
contrast_a: A visible obstacle or vehicle is in front of the ego vehicle.
contrast_b: No visible obstacle or vehicle is in front of the ego vehicle.

dimension: Braking occurrence relative to front-obstacle presence
contrast_a: Vehicle brakes or stops while no obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle.
contrast_b: Vehicle does not brake or stop while no obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle.

dimension: Presence of an obstacle or collision-relevant object ahead of the vehicle
contrast_a: A situation in which an obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking may be required to avoid collision
contrast_b: A situation in which no obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle

dimension: Braking occurrence with no visible trigger ahead
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes or stops although no obstacle or vehicle is in front.
contrast_b: The vehicle does not brake in the same situation.

dimension: presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: No obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_b: An obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle

dimension: Presence of a relevant forward obstacle in the stated operational situation
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle

dimension: Intentionality of braking
contrast_a: Braking is intended as part of a valid braking maneuver to avoid a collision with an obstacle.
contrast_b: Braking is unintended, i.e. the vehicle suddenly stops although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.

dimension: Presence of an obstacle in the vehicle's forward path
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.

dimension: Braking outcome
contrast_a: The vehicle continues driving normally without an unintended stop.
contrast_b: The vehicle suddenly stops although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.

dimension: Presence of a relevant obstacle ahead of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the declared operational situation.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the declared operational situation.

dimension: Presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking is a response to it.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking occurs anyway.

dimension: Braking state relative to the presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: Vehicle brakes or stops while no obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_b: Vehicle brakes or stops in response to an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle

dimension: Presence of a forward obstacle
contrast_a: Obstacle present in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_b: No obstacle in front of the ego vehicle

dimension: Brake application outcome
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes as intended to avoid an obstacle or for another justified braking purpose within the operational situation.
contrast_b: The vehicle brakes without an obstacle in front, i.e. an unintended braking event occurs.

dimension: Presence of obstacle ahead in the driving path
contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the relevant trajectory.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.

dimension: presence of a relevant obstacle ahead
contrast_a: An obstacle is present ahead of the ego vehicle such that braking is intended to avoid a collision.
contrast_b: No obstacle is present ahead of the ego vehicle.

dimension: braking intent
contrast_a: Intended braking performed to avoid collisions with obstacles
contrast_b: Unintended braking with no obstacle in front of the vehicle

dimension: Presence of an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle
contrast_a: No obstacle is present in front of the vehicle
contrast_b: An obstacle is present in front of the vehicle

dimension: Braking occurrence relative to the driving situation
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes unintentionally / suddenly stops while no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.
contrast_b: The vehicle does not brake unintentionally in the same situation.

dimension: Braking state relative to the driving situation
contrast_a: Vehicle is braking or has suddenly stopped without an obstacle in front.
contrast_b: Vehicle continues driving without unintended braking in the same road situation.

dimension: Braking outcome in the declared operational situation
contrast_a: The vehicle does not brake unintentionally.
contrast_b: The vehicle suddenly stops although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle.

dimension: Braking occurrence in the stated no-obstacle driving situation
contrast_a: The vehicle brakes or stops suddenly while no obstacle is in front of it.
contrast_b: The vehicle does not brake unexpectedly and continues driving normally in the same situation.

dimension: Braking occurrence in the absence of a detected obstacle ahead
contrast_a: Vehicle does not brake
contrast_b: Vehicle brakes or stops unexpectedly although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle

dimension: Braking cause
contrast_a: Braking occurs because an obstacle is present or detected in front of the ego vehicle.
contrast_b: Braking occurs although no obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.
